probe_meta.label: dense-G (controlled retrieval-mechanism swap of Probe G)

response_text:
1. (Currently Amended) An air braking unit for use in an air braking system, the air braking unit being arranged to be positioned, in use, at a vehicle wheel, and comprising: an inlet for receiving, in use, compressed air from a central source; at least one first valve arranged to selectively allow compressed air from the inlet to enter a wheel brake chamber in use; at least one second valve arranged to selectively allow air from the brake chamber to be released via an outlet to the atmosphere in use; and control means for controlling the first and second valves to operate to selectively control the air pressure in the brake chamber in use, __wherein the control means comprises a microprocessor-based electronic control unit configured to receive and process sensor signals to dynamically modulate valve operation independent of manual brake pedal input__.

2. (Currently Amended) The air braking unit of claim 1, further comprising __at least two__ plural first valves and/or plural second valves, __wherein the plural valves are configured to operate in coordinated sequence__.

3. (Currently Amended) The air braking unit of claim 2, wherein the plural valves may comprise one or more larger valves arranged to allow large volumes of air to pass therethrough and one or more smaller valves arranged to allow passage of smaller volumes of air therethrough, __wherein the larger and smaller valves are independently controlled by the microprocessor-based electronic control unit__.

4. (Currently Amended) The air braking unit of claim 3, wherein the one or more smaller valves are arranged to operate at high speed, __and wherein the high-speed operation is controlled by the electronic control unit to achieve modulation frequencies greater than 10 Hz__.

5. (Currently Amended) The air braking unit of any preceding claim, wherein one or more of the valves are driven by binary actuators, __and wherein the control means is configured to pulse the binary actuators at variable duty cycles to achieve proportional braking force control__.

6. (Currently Amended) An air braking unit according to any preceding claim, wherein the control means is arranged to receive control signals from a wheel speed sensor and an air pressure sensor for determining the pressure in the brake chamber, __and wherein the control means is further configured to calculate wheel slip in real-time and adjust valve operation to prevent wheel lockup__.

7. (Currently Amended) An air braking unit according to claim 6, wherein the control means is arranged to receive data from a vehicle speed sensor, and reference data indicative of an optimum braking force for given vehicle and wheel speeds and control braking force based thereon, __wherein the reference data is stored in a lookup table within the electronic control unit and is updated dynamically based on road surface conditions detected by the sensors__.

8. (Currently Amended) An air braking unit according to claim 6 or claim 7, wherein the control means is arranged to determine, from the sensors, and stored reference data, an optimum speed for each wheel and to control the braking force on each wheel in accordance with the calculated optimum speed, __wherein the control means implements an anti-lock braking algorithm that independently controls each wheel's braking pressure__.

9. (Currently Amended) An air braking system comprising one or more units according to any preceding claim; a pump for generating compressed air; and a central compressed air storage tank, __wherein the system further comprises a central electronic control module in communication with the electronic control units of each air braking unit via a vehicle communication bus__.
